messages:
maria: Quick rollup — rolling up ownership/timeline for the next dedicated GPU slate. TL;DR: procurement PO placed, ETA ~Mar 28, but two infra blockers (cross-connect & firmware window). Calling out owners and quick asks below.

sam: PO number + shipping ETA? also which racks are in scope?

maria: PO `PO-4821` placed yesterday. Vendor ETA shows arrival 2026-03-28. Slate covers racks r24-r27 (4 nodes x 8 GPUs). Reservation id for booking: `res-20260328-87`.

leo: Noted. Cross-connect request submitted to netops, ticket #NET-7894. Waiting on provider SLA confirm; estimate 48h. If they miss the window we'll need to push the rack power test.

anya: Firmware/BIOS update schedule: we need a 2h maintenance window per rack for the vendor image + nvlink firmware. @sam @dinesh can you confirm availability next Tue/Wed?

sam: Tue (3/23) morning is tight for SRE on-call. Wed (3/24) afternoon looks free. prefer Wed.

dinesh: Wed afternoon works for infra. I'll block `15:00-18:00 UTC` for the firmware window and add rollback playbook to the runbook.

maria: Thanks. That means timeline looks like: arrival 3/28 -> racking 3/29 -> power/cabling + smoke 3/30 -> firmware can be done during provisioning if netops confirms cross-connect earlier.

kate: Quick note on capacity reservations: billing needs the committed timeline to lock in Dedicated SKUs. If we slide >72h we'll need a contract amendment. Can someone flag if the ETA drifts?

leo: Netops said provider confirmation by EOD today. If they don't confirm, plan B is to stage racking but hold on public tag until connectivity validated.

anya: Also found one software dependency: `kvcache` upgrade (PR open) must land before we enable persistent KV on the new nodes. PR is here: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2145 — needs one more review.

maria: @leo can you ping the netops PO for an explicit EOD confirm? @kate I cc'd finance on the PO email thread to track amendment trigger.

leo: on it, pinged PO and vendor lead in-thread.

deploy-bot: CI: PR #2145 checks passed ✅ (unit + e2e).

sam: I'll do the final review on PR #2145 today and merge if green.

dinesh: Action items for me: prep rollback scripts, pre-seed NTP/monitoring, and validate GPU driver bundle (nv-14.5). ETA EOD tomorrow.

maria: Nice. Summary of action items: 1) leo -> netops vendor confirm (EOD) 2) sam -> PR review + merge (today) 3) dinesh -> firmware + rollback prep (EOD tomorrow) 4) kate -> watch contract amendment trigger if ETA slips. I'll update the shared tracking sheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/capacity-slate-2026 (please update your rows).

sam: one more ask — can infra create a short runbook stub in the repo (`docs/oncall/dedicated-slate.md`) so support has steps for partial fallout? small checklist is enough.

dinesh: will add the runbook stub after firmware tests, link back here.

maria: Great. If netops confirms we stay on current timeline; if not we'll reconvene and set new committed dates. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

leo: noted, will follow up. :eyes:
